items.why: Leading the chip selloff. Barron's notes the rest of the market is rallying while chips fall, and CNBC reports investors rotating out of tech shares.
Treasury yields falling as the Dow rallies and tech slides. MarketWatch and the WSJ both flag dropping yields alongside the rotation out of tech.
Down with the chip and AI selloff. The Nasdaq is sliding as investors rotate out of tech, with AI names extending declines after the hot inflation reading.
Gold getting a safety bid. Hot inflation data stirs rate-hike worries, per Reuters, so money is parking in gold while tech churns.

market_note: S&P futures nearly flat, Nasdaq futures down 0.6%, Dow futures up 1.1%.
summary: Rotation day: money is leaving chips and big tech for value names, pushing the Dow up while the Nasdaq slides a second straight day. Easing Treasury yields are helping the broader market hold up.
